document.lead: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.

text: The pie chart illustrates the main reasons people gave for moving house in one country in 2024, expressed as percentages of all moves.

Overall, work or study was the most common reason for moving, followed by the wish for a larger home. Together, these two reasons explain around half of all moves, while each of the remaining four reasons was given by a smaller share of people.

The most frequently mentioned reason was a new job or place of study, which accounted for 29% of moves. Just over a fifth of people (22%) said they had moved because they wanted a bigger home, so these two reasons made up 51% of the total, just over half.

Among the less common reasons, 16% of people moved to be closer to their family, and a slightly smaller proportion (14%) moved to reduce their living costs. Better local schools were the reason for 11% of moves, which is less than half the figure for work or study. The remaining 8% of people moved for a variety of other reasons.

note.en: Introduces the overview — the big picture without numbers.
note.ru: Открывает overview — общий итог без цифр.

note.en: Places the second-largest sector after the first.
note.kk: Көлемі бойынша екінші бөлікті біріншісінен кейін қояды.
note.ru: Ставит второй по величине сектор после первого.

note.en: Combines two sectors into one share.
note.ru: Объединяет два сектора в одну долю.

note.en: Contrasts the large and small sectors.
note.kk: Үлкен және кіші бөліктерді қарсы қояды.

note.en: Attaches the figure to the reason.
A conclusion: the total of two shares.
Moves on to the smaller sectors.
Closes the description with the last sector.

strengths.en: Two sectors are added up to show their combined weight: “51% of the total, just over half”.
strengths.kk: Екі бөлік қосылған — олардың жалпы рөлі осылай көрсетілген: «51% of the total, just over half».
strengths.ru: Два сектора сложены — так показана их общая роль: «51% of the total, just over half».
strengths.example: 51% of the total, just over half

strengths.en: “Just over a fifth” and “less than half the figure” compare instead of listing bare numbers.
strengths.kk: «Just over a fifth», «less than half the figure» — жалаң сандардың орнына салыстыру.
strengths.ru: «Just over a fifth», «less than half the figure» — сравнения вместо голых цифр.
strengths.example: Just over a fifth of people (22%)

strengths.en: Accounted for, made up, was the reason for — not the same “was” every time.
strengths.kk: accounted for, made up, was the reason for — бір сарынды «was»-сыз.
strengths.ru: accounted for, made up, was the reason for — без однообразного «was».

strengths.en: The chart has a year (2024), so the answer is in the past, unlike an undated chart.
strengths.kk: Диаграммада жыл бар (2024), сондықтан жауап өткен шақта — жылсыз диаграммадан айырмашылығы осы.
strengths.ru: У диаграммы есть год (2024), поэтому ответ в прошедшем времени — в отличие от диаграммы без года.
strengths.example: 16% of people moved to be closer to their family

note.en: One chart with a year, so the answer is in the past simple. It adds that the shares are of all moves.
note.kk: Жылы бар бір диаграмма — жауап past simple-мен. Үлестер барлық көшуден алынғаны қосылған.
note.ru: Одна диаграмма с годом — ответ в past simple. Добавлено, что доли — от всех переездов.

note.en: The two main sectors, which together make about half, and the rest noticeably smaller.
note.kk: Екі басты бөлік және олардың бірге жартыға жуық екені, қалғандары едәуір аз.
note.ru: Два главных сектора и то, что вместе они около половины, остальные заметно меньше.

note.en: The two largest sectors and their total: 29 + 22 = 51, “just over half”.
note.kk: Ең үлкен екі бөлік және олардың қосындысы: 29 + 22 = 51, «just over half».
note.ru: Два самых крупных сектора и их сумма: 29 + 22 = 51, «just over half».

note.en: The smaller sectors in descending order, compared with the largest one.
note.kk: Кішірек бөліктер кему ретімен, ең үлкенімен салыстырылған.
note.ru: Меньшие сектора по убыванию, со сравнением с самым крупным.
